messages:
anya: kicking off a tiny canary for quant4v2 on user-chat cohort A. low-risk slice, ~2% traffic. checking latency, QA-f1, and hallucination probe.
michael: sg. what's the threshold matrix for auto-fallback? can we keep it conservative for this first pass?
sam: propose: p95 latency delta <= +12ms, token cost change <= +3%, QA-F1 drop <= 0.8 absolute? hallucination rate delta <= +0.5% (measured on halluc-slice).
priya: +1 to conservative. also add a semantic divergence check — cosine-emb drift on anchor prompts < 0.02.
anya: added. updating canary config now.
anya: deploy-bot: start canary quant4v2 -> 2% traffic cohort=A
deploy-bot: canary started (id: canary-2026-07-22-01). monitoring endpoints: /metrics/canary/canary-2026-07-22-01
michael: running smoke eval on longform and code samples — will paste quick stats in 10m.
sam: quick note: KV-warmup might bias latency early. ensure we compare steady-state windows (after 5m).
priya: good call. also sample user IDs to avoid hot-user skew.
anya: config snippet:
```
canary:
  id: canary-2026-07-22-01
  traffic: 0.02
  cohorts: [A]
  metrics:
    - name: latency_p95
      max_delta_ms: 12
    - name: qa_f1
      max_abs_drop: 0.8
    - name: hallucination_rate
      max_delta_pct: 0.5
    - name: embed_cosine_drift
      max_delta: 0.02
  evaluation_window: 15m
  steady_state_delay: 5m
  auto_fallback: true
```
michael: saw initial p95 +8ms, cost +1.7%, QA-F1 -0.2, hallucination +0.1%. looks fine at first glance.
sam: can we see slice breakdown? especially code-gen and multi-turn support prompts.
anya: dumping slice table -> small attached CSV link: https://redwood.internal/canary/canary-2026-07-22-01/slices.csv
priya: code-gen slice has QA-F1 -1.1 on 50 samples (ouch). but multi-turn prose is +0.0.
michael: that's concerning. is code-gen latency affected? any token cutoff or truncation?
sam: checking logs: one host had kv-cache misses during warmup — some responses truncated then regenerated, which hurt code-gen QA-F1.
anya: ops: can we warm the KV cache for the canary cohort and re-run? otherwise we should halt auto-fallback until warmup fixed.
deploy-bot: canary health check failed: metric code_gen_qa_f1 exceeded threshold (-1.1 < -0.8). initiating hold.
anya: holding — thanks. disabling auto_fallback temporarily and spinning a warmup job.
priya: reminder: for future canaries, include a KV-warmup pre-step in the rollout plan.
michael: agree. postmortem idea: add synthetic long-code prompts to the warmup corpus.
sam: plan: rerun after warmup with same 2% traffic but mark evaluation window to exclude first 7m. I'll queue that.
anya: noted. I'm updating the rollout runbook to explicitly require steady-state start after warmup and to gate code-gen slice independently (separate metric).
priya: and set a lower auto_fallback sensitivity for critical slices initially.
anya: thanks team. tagging @oncall if anything flares. I'll update thread when rerun completes. :thumbsup:
